description: This file defines the class FileCookieJar, which manages persistent storage of cookies, including loading from and saving to a JSON file, within the Guzzle HTTP client library.

classes.name: FileCookieJar
classes.description: A cookie jar that persists cookies to a JSON formatted file, supporting both session and persistent cookies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FileCookieJar with a filename and optional session cookie persistence flag, and loads existing cookies if the file exists.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Saves cookies to the file upon object destruction.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes the cookies to JSON and writes them to the specified file.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads cookies from a JSON file, adding them to the cookie jar, handling errors appropriately.
